best_for: Windows home users who want a one-click cleanup of junk files and browser traces, and who might pay for automatic cleaning and driver updates.
description:
CCleaner is a PC cleanup tool that Piriform first released in 2004. Piriform says it has passed 2 billion downloads and gets more than 5 million desktop installs a week.

Piriform makes a few other Windows tools that go with it: Recuva brings back files you deleted by mistake, Speccy shows what hardware is inside your PC, and Defraggler defragments hard drives. At the time of reading, the Pro Plus plan added Recuva Pro and Speccy Pro, and the Premium Bundle added those two plus Kamo, a privacy tool for stopping online tracking.

points.title: Free does the manual cleaning
points.text: The free version covers standard cleaning, standard privacy cleaning and a basic Health Check. You run it yourself when you want.

points.title: Automation and updates are paid
points.text: Driver Updater, the software updater, Performance Optimizer, automatic browser-history cleaning, tracker removal, cloud drive cleaning and priority support start at Professional.

points.title: Prices
points.text: Professional is listed at USD 44.95 for one PC and Pro Plus at USD 64.95 for up to 3 devices, with a 30-day money-back guarantee. The plans page does not spell out the renewal term. Prices were read on the date below.

points.title: Owned by Gen Digital
points.text: CCleaner and Piriform belong to Gen Digital, the company behind Norton and Avast, and its privacy policy is the Gen group policy.

points.title: Windows listing runs behind
points.text: The newest build here is 7.11, while CCleaner's version history shows 7.14 from November 18, 2026. The Windows listing keeps 55 versions and installs machine-wide, in 32-bit and 64-bit builds.

points.title: The Mac app is a different product
points.text: CCleaner for Mac is version 2.x with its own feature set: free cleaning, duplicate finder and uninstaller, with photo analysis and automatic browser cleaning in the paid tiers. Only the current Mac release is listed.
